recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: single-board tinkering locked behind soldered RAM
AI memory that refuses to summarize away the details
camera sensors sniffing for lenses in the room
autumn overcast settling over San Francisco before dawn
equinox fog thinning toward a 17°C afternoon
agents waiting to spin up from a pocket shortcut

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Snatch glowing memory shards before compression waves blur them into summaries — each fragment you save keeps one crisp detail alive.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: tap to grab nearby shards, swipe to dodge incoming compression waves
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: every shard rescued adds a sharp pixel to a growing lossless mosaic
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: compression waves arrive faster and merge more shards per sweep
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: amber phosphor fragments on charcoal autumn fog

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Rhythm-tap solder pads on a sealed Pi board before molten traces flood each mod slot shut.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: hold on a pad until the trace glows, release before the solder flood closes it
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: perfect timing unlocks one more mod slot before the board hardens forever
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: trace paths branch in parallel and solder bleeds from multiple edges at once
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: green PCB copper etch with molten silver bleed

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Sweep sightlines through a grey room to catch hidden camera glints before they blink and vanish.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: drag to paint a detection beam, release when a lens flare catches the sweep
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: each clean sweep maps another corner and adds it to your room blueprint
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: decoy reflections multiply and glints fade faster between sweeps
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: thermal noir with pale lens flares on overcast walls

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick sunrise shipment crates down foggy SF lanes before the 2026 countdown hits zero.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: swipe to flick crates into delivery lanes, tap to brake mid-roll
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: chained deliveries paint terminal-green trails through the morning fog
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: lanes merge, fog thickens, and the deadline clock ticks louder each delivery
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: watercolor fog with terminal-green UI chrome
